First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NorthStar Cycling Sunday Service group ride

A Sunday no-drop ride organized by and for Black, Brown and Indigenous riders in Seattle. Easy pace, rolls from the club's Central District clubhouse. The club's stated aim is to take down barriers to cycling and support riders' physical and mental health. All bikes welcome.
